ex.en: I'm taking Spanish this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修西班牙文。

ex.en: The new school semester has started.
ex.zh: 新學期開始了。

ex.en: I haven't studied physics much all semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期幾乎沒念物理。

ex.en: More than 90 percent of visits to a web page are from search engines.
ex.zh: 網頁超過九成的造訪量來自搜尋引擎。

ex.en: One of the major Internet search engines states that ‘Fast is better than slow’.
ex.zh: 某個主要的網路搜尋引擎說：「快比慢好。」

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器半夜會關機。

ex.en: This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
ex.zh: 必須立刻停止這個程序，否則伺服器會當機。

ex.en: The server is a bit slow.
ex.zh: 伺服器有點慢。

ex.en: Our server was very friendly.
ex.zh: 我們的服務生很親切。

ex.en: Ask the server for the bill.
ex.zh: 跟服務生要帳單。

ex.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
ex.zh: 他們雖然結婚了，卻分房睡。

ex.en: Please keep the receipts in a separate folder.
ex.zh: 請把收據放在另一個資料夾。

ex.en: A sea separates Ireland and England.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭和英格蘭之間隔著一片海。

ex.en: My home is separated from his by a river.
ex.zh: 我家和他家隔著一條河。

ex.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
ex.zh: 在我們的城市，大家都會仔細做垃圾分類。

ex.en: Her parents separated when she was ten.
ex.zh: 她十歲時父母就分居了。

ex.en: They separated but never got divorced.
ex.zh: 他們分居了，但一直沒有離婚。

ex.en: Is there a service charge for that?
ex.zh: 這要收服務費嗎？

ex.en: The bill includes a 10% service charge.
ex.zh: 帳單包含一成服務費。

ex.en: Office workers often have a sedentary lifestyle.
ex.zh: 上班族常常過著久坐不動的生活。

ex.en: A sedentary job can cause back problems.
ex.zh: 久坐的工作可能導致背部問題。

ex.en: Lucario is a creature in the Pokémon series.
ex.zh: 路卡利歐是《寶可夢》系列中的一種寶可夢。

ex.en: I'm watching a Korean drama series on Netflix.
ex.zh: 我在 Netflix 上追一部韓劇。

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸使實驗室成為廢墟。

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下進行了一連串的實驗。

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: The sequel was even better than the first movie.
ex.zh: 續集比第一集還好看。

ex.en: The author is writing a sequel to her best-selling novel.
ex.zh: 作者正在寫她暢銷小說的續集。

ex.en: I like spring the best of the seasons.
ex.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節。

ex.en: Which season do you like best, spring or autumn?
ex.zh: 春天和秋天，你比較喜歡哪個季節？

ex.en: Kyoto is packed with people during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假期期間，京都人山人海。

ex.en: Hotels are expensive during the tourist season.
ex.zh: 觀光旺季時飯店都很貴。

ex.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
ex.zh: 我用鹽和胡椒幫魚調味。

ex.en: Season the soup with a little salt.
ex.zh: 用一點鹽幫湯調味。

ex.en: The newspaper was criticized for its sensationalism.
ex.zh: 這家報紙因為煽情報導而受到批評。

ex.en: Good journalism avoids sensationalism.
ex.zh: 好的新聞報導會避免譁眾取寵。

ex.en: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
ex.zh: 還不錯。你去了今天的歷史研討課嗎？

ex.en: How was the seminar?
ex.zh: 研討會怎麼樣？

ex.en: This restaurant serves French cuisine, but with Japanese tableware.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應法式料理，但用的是日式餐具。

ex.en: Although I had ordered tea, he served me coffee.
ex.zh: 雖然我點的是茶，他卻給我上了咖啡。

ex.en: The takoyaki served at this restaurant is a delight.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的章魚燒很好吃。

ex.en: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.
ex.zh: 能為您服務，我會非常高興。

ex.en: She served in the army for two years.
ex.zh: 她在軍中服役兩年。

ex.en: All these things serve to add to our happiness.
ex.zh: 這些都能讓我們更幸福。

ex.en: The accident served as a warning to all drivers.
ex.zh: 這場意外對所有駕駛都是一個警惕。

ex.en: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的服務一點也不快。

ex.en: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
ex.zh: 有些國家公園設有淋浴間，甚至還會提供托兒服務。

ex.en: There is an air service between Tokyo and Moscow.
ex.zh: 東京和莫斯科之間有航班往來。

ex.en: Train service will resume tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 火車明天早上恢復行駛。

ex.en: By coincidence, these two are still being serviced.
ex.zh: 真巧，這兩台目前都還在維修。

ex.en: I need to get my car serviced.
ex.zh: 我的車需要送去保養。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt, please.
ex.zh: 請繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
ex.zh: 要是湯姆繫上安全帶的話，他就不會死的。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Employees who were laid off received severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁員的員工拿到了資遣費。

ex.en: The company offered three months' severance.
ex.zh: 公司提供三個月的資遣費。
